column1: #  Hard-coded artefact-pixel repairs, transcribed verbatim from
#  (lines 74-129). These are manual, eyeballed corrections of Capture Hi-C
#  ligation artefacts at 5 kb; they are human judgement, not an algorithm, so
#  they ship as data rather than being re-invented in code.
#  cooler_pattern  fnmatch pattern against the cooler NAME (no .cool suffix).
#  tag             snpsplit tag the fix applies to: G1, G2, or `any` for both.
#                  The original tested `"G1" in basename(cf)` / `"G2" in ...`.
#  bin1_start      start1 of the pixel to replace (end1 = bin1_start + 5000).
#  bin2_start      start2 of the pixel to replace (end2 = bin2_start + 5000).
#                    mean    -> rounded mean of whatever subset of the 8
#                               neighbours (+/-5 kb in each axis) exists.
#                    top     -> rounded mean of exactly v1,v2,v3,v4,v5
#                    bottom  -> rounded mean of exactly v4,v5,v6,v7,v8
#                    left    -> rounded mean of exactly v1,v2,v4,v6,v7
#                    right   -> rounded mean of exactly v2,v3,v5,v7,v8
#                  NOTE the directional modes index v1..v8 directly, so a
#                  missing neighbour is a NameError in the original. All four
#                  directional uses here are interior pixels, so this never
#                  fired -- but the reimplementation must reproduce the exact
#                  5-neighbour subset, not a "mean of what exists".
#  Counts (assert these):  Mecp2 G1 = 2, Mecp2 G2 = 5, Jarid G1 = 1, Jarid G2 = 7
#  In `fixtures.mode: auto` this whole step is skipped, with a warning.
